ClampMin.description: Clamps numeric input to minimum value
ClampMin.source: Unreal Garden: "ClampMin and ClampMax for numbers"

ClampMax.description: Clamps numeric input to maximum value
ClampMax.source: Unreal Garden: "ClampMin and ClampMax for numbers"

UIMin.description: Sets UI slider minimum value (does not clamp)
UIMin.source: UE Docs: "UIMin and UIMax for numeric properties (all integer and floating-point types)"

UIMax.description: Sets UI slider maximum value (does not clamp)
UIMax.source: UE Docs: "UIMax and UIMax for numeric properties (all integer and floating-point types)"

BindWidget.description: Binds UMG widget property to widget in blueprint
BindWidget.source: UE Docs: "BindWidget meta tag for UMG widget binding"

BindWidgetOptional.description: Optional widget binding (no error if widget not found)

InlineEditConditionToggle.description: Creates inline checkbox for edit condition

MakeEditWidget.description: Makes vector editable as 3D widget in viewport

BindWidgetAnim.description: Binds UMG animation property to animation in blueprint
BindWidgetAnim.source: UE Docs: "BindWidgetAnim for UMG animation binding"

GetOptions.description: Specifies function that returns dropdown options. Property stores selected value (not array).
GetOptions.source: UE Docs: "GetOptions for dynamic dropdown in Details panel"

AllowPrivateAccess.description: Allows Blueprint access to private/protected properties
AllowPrivateAccess.source: UE Docs: "AllowPrivateAccess for Blueprint exposure of non-public properties"

EditCondition.description: Conditionally shows property based on bool property
EditCondition.source: UE Docs: "EditCondition for conditional property visibility"

DisplayThumbnail.description: Displays asset thumbnail in Details panel (asset types only)
